analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved, documented, and tested within a Docker environment.
requirements_understanding: The legacy application is a VB6 banking system with multiple forms and ActiveX dependencies.
Modernization involves rewriting the application in C# while maintaining existing functionality.
The project requires documenting current functionality, designing architecture, implementing services, and conducting QA/security checks.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Legacy VB6 forms and controls will be mapped to C# equivalents using Windows Forms or WPF.
ActiveX and DLL dependencies will be replaced with .NET libraries or custom implementations.
Docker will be used for local testing and deployment, requiring containerization of the C# application.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific changes to business logic that need to be implemented during modernization?
What are the specific security requirements for the modernized application?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring all functionalities are preserved and tested within a Docker environment.

project.name: BankingAppModernization
project.objective: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved, documented, and tested within a Docker environment.

recommended_strategy.name: Phased UI migration
recommended_strategy.rationale: Incremental form-by-form migration balances risk and delivery speed while preserving behavior.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
